name: Trigonos LAYRO floor layout marking robot
summary: Light 16 kg robot that drives to each layout point and marks points, lines, axes and ID labels on concrete floors, tracked by a total station or laser tracker. Used for halls and plant installation in Germany and Hungary.

germany.statusNote: No sales page read. Trigonos ran its own marking jobs in Germany (Rastatt, Sindelfingen) and supplied a second robot to a client metrology team in Debrecen, Hungary, but no seller route was found.

specs.label: Power
specs.quote: Two 18V batteries, hot-swappable without stopping the marking run

specs.label: Positioning
specs.value: Leica total station or API/Hexagon laser tracker
specs.quote: a Leica total station, or an API or Hexagon laser tracker

notes: Semi-autonomous: drives to each point and marks it; one operator sets up the measuring device and supervises.
Also measures floor heights below 0.5 mm.

evidence.task: Marked more than 10,000 floor points over two weeks
evidence.note: Trigonos own job, reported by Robots in Construction.

evidence.task: Marked more than 5,000 floor points within a few days

openQuestions: Maker website and company details were not found; maker country DE is inferred from the German project sites on the page read.
Price on request; no seller route found.
